concept: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

prompt_en: A photorealistic gothic romantic photograph, combining ornate dark textures with pale blossoms and warm gold illumination, presents a person whose facial appearance and hair draw from the supplied photograph in a coherent complex scene. The atmosphere is serene, still, ethereal and quietly melancholic. She is a fictional adult stage technician in an empty chamber rehearsal room, pausing after a small adjustment to an old scenic shutter beside a compact organ. Her dark jaw-length bob has softly separated wispy bangs; brown eyes, a gently rounded facial outline, a small straight nose and natural soft pink lips retain the visible reference cues. A high-collared black lace blouse with botanical embroidery follows her relaxed shoulders; its long sleeves crease naturally at the elbows. Her right hand grips a black velvet pull cord at waist height, with the elbow comfortably bent beside her torso. The taut cord rises through a small visible pulley on the shutter frame and attaches to one hinged gilt leaf. That leaf is held slightly open, producing a thin vertical seam of warm golden light just behind her shoulder. One continuous, mostly leafless brown branch is anchored to the shutter's upper frame, bearing small ivory flowers at distinct nodes with bare woody intervals between them; this sparse contour lets the golden seam remain visible. A companion flowering twig occupies the farther side, and a delicate branch shadow falls across the adjacent charcoal wall. She quietly studies the new width of the glowing seam, lips softly parted, the left hand resting open on the edge of the organ bench. Her stance is upright and easy. The organ pipes and worn bench establish the rehearsal space while staying subordinate to her attentive presence. Her face is the first focal point, the holding hand and line of light the second, and the pale blossoms and dark carved surface the third. A chest-height capture camera sees her from a gentle front three-quarter position in a vertical medium portrait, including both hands, the visible pulley and the organ bench edge. A natural 50mm perspective and moderate depth of field keep the connected mechanism readable. The light grazes her bob and lace, with broad soft frontal fill retaining natural skin texture. Soft neutral-cool fill keeps the central forehead, nose and cheeks pale and cool-toned; only the seam-facing cheek rim, jaw edge and ear take a restrained warm reflection from the gilt leaf, so the two illumination zones remain visibly separate. Antique gold, ivory and charcoal sit in a muted low-contrast grade with lifted matte blacks, soft ivory highlight roll-off and fine film grain; photorealistic fine-art photography.

Preserve the same facial features, dark bob, wispy fringe, outfit, sparse flowering branch and quiet expression while clarifying the local shutter connection and source-bound face illumination. Her right hand keeps its existing grip on the same black velvet pull cord beside her torso, with the elbow comfortably bent. Above her right hand, the same black pull cord climbs in an unobstructed vertical line to a small brass pulley on the fixed top rail. Its continuous strand wraps visibly over the pulley, then runs in a short diagonal segment to a tight knot through a clearly visible mounting hole in the upper inner edge of the movable gilt shutter leaf. The pulley groove, diagonal rope segment, terminal knot and shutter-leaf hinge occupy clear space below the top rail and beside the sparse flowering branch. Tension from her grip pulls that leaf a few degrees away from its stationary companion, maintaining the same thin vertical seam of warm golden light behind her shoulder. Her face is the first focal point, the holding hand and line of light the second, and the pale blossoms and dark carved surface the third. The warm gold source travels through the same slit, strikes the nearby gilt inner edge, and rebounds onto a thin strip of her seam-facing temple, cheek rim and jaw contour. This amber skin rim is clearly visible on actual skin, separate from the stronger gold line on her hair; the forehead, nose and central cheeks retain their cooler tone.
